cards.front: هر چند پیر و خسته‌دل و ناتوان شدم
cards.back:
However old, incapable,
And heart-sick I may be,
The moment I recall your face
My youth's restored to me;

cards.front: زلف آشفته و خوی‌کرده و خندان‌لب و مست
cards.back:
Last night she brought me wine, and sat beside my pillow;
Her hair hung loose, her dress was torn, her face perspired –
She smiled and sang of love, with mischief in her eyes,
And whispering in my ear, she drunkenly inquired:

cards.front: گل بی رخ یار خوش نباشد
cards.back:
A flower, without a friend's face there, I think
that isn't good

cards.front: یاری اندر کس نمی‌بینم یاران را چه شد
cards.back:
I see no love in anyone,
Where, then, have all the lovers gone?

cards.front: صحن بستان ذوق‌بخش و صحبت یاران خوش است
cards.back:
The orchard charms our hearts, and chatter when
our dearest friends appear – is sweet;

cards.front: برد از من قرار و طاقت و هوش
cards.back:
Sweet lips and silver ears – that idol's elegance
Has snatched away my fortitude, and my good sense;

cards.front: الا یا ایها الساقی ادر کاسا و ناولها
cards.back: Come, boy, and pass the wine around –

cards.front: روی تو کس ندید و هزارت رقیب هست
cards.back:
No one has seen your face, and yet
Thousands of rivals seek you;

cards.front: حال دل با تو گفتنم هوس است
cards.back:
To tell you now my poor heart's state
is what I long for

cards.front: المنة لله که در میکده باز است
cards.back:
Thanks be to God now that the wine-shop door
Is open, since it's there I'm heading for;

cards.front: گل در بر و می در کف و معشوقه به کام است
cards.back:
Wine in my glass, and roses in my arms,
my lover near me –

cards.front: برو به کار خود ای واعظ این چه فریادست
cards.back:
Go, mind your own business, preacher! What's all
This hullabaloo?

cards.front: خوش آمد گل و زان خوشتر نباشد
cards.back:
Welcome, sweet flower, no one's
More welcome in this land –

cards.front: بیا تا گل برافشانیم و می در ساغر اندازیم
cards.back:
Come, so that we can scatter flowers
and fill the glass with wine,

cards.front: منم که گوشهٔ میخانه خانقاه من است
cards.back:
A corner of the wine-shop is
the temple where I pray;

cards.front: بغیر از آنکه بشد دین و دانش از دستم
cards.back:
Come, tell me what it is that I have gained
From loving you,
Apart from losing all the faith I had
And knowledge too?

cards.front: روز وصل دوستداران یاد باد
cards.back:
Those days when loving friends would meet –
long may they be recalled!

cards.front: یوسف گمگشته بازآید به کنعان غم مخور
cards.back:
Lost Joseph will return to Canaan's land again
– do not despair

cards.front: دوش آگهی ز یار سفرکرده داد باد
cards.back:
Last night, news of my departed friend
Was brought to me upon the wind;

cards.front: شراب و عیش نهان چیست کار بی‌بنیاد
cards.back: What's all this hiding happiness and wine away?

cards.front: درد عشقی کشیده‌ام که مپرس
cards.back: I've known the pains of love's frustration – ah, don't ask!

cards.front: عیب رندان مکن ای زاهد پاکیزه‌سرشت
cards.back:
That you're a pious prig by nature
Doesn't mean you have to blame
Libertines for their faults; those sins
Won't be imputed to your name.

cards.front: مزرع سبز فلک دیدم و داس مه نو
cards.back:
I saw the green fields of the sky,
and there a sickle moon –

cards.front: خوشتر ز عیش و صحبت و باغ و بهار چیست
cards.back:
What's sweeter than a garden and good talk
When spring's new flowers appear?

cards.front: دوش دیدم که ملایک در میخانه زدند
cards.back:
Last night I saw the angels
tapping at the wine-shop's door,

cards.front: سال‌ها دل طلب جام جم از ما می‌کرد
cards.back:
For years my heart inquired of me
Where Jamshid's sacred cup might be,

cards.front: دوش وقت سحر از غصه نجاتم دادند
cards.back:
Last night, at dawn, in my distress, salvation
was given to me;

cards.front: یارم چو قدح به دست گیرد
cards.back:
When my love lifts his glass,
throughout the town
Love's market suddenly
comes tumbling down.

cards.front: درخت دوستی بنشان که کام دل به بار آرد
cards.back:
Plant friendship’s tree – the heart’s desire
Is the fruit it bears;

cards.front: من ترک عشق و شاهد و ساغر نمی‌کنم
cards.back:
To give up wine, and human beauty? And to give up love?
No, I won’t do it.

cards.front: مرا به رندی و عشق آن فضول عیب کند
cards.back:
That busybody criticizes me
For loving love and revelry –

cards.front: نوش کن جام شراب یک منی
cards.back:
Drink wine down by the glassful, and you’ll tear
Out of your heart the roots of your despair –

cards.front: عشق تو نهال حیرت آمد
cards.back:
My love for you is like a youthful tree
of wonder

cards.front: صبا وقت سحر بویی ز زلف یار می‌آورد
cards.back:
At dawn, upon the breeze, I caught
the scent of my belovèd’s hair,

cards.front: دانی که چنگ و عود چه تقریر می‌کنند
cards.back:
Do you know what our harps and lutes advise us,
when heard aright?

cards.front: یاد باد آنکه سر کوی توام منزل بود
cards.back:
What memories! I once lived on
the street that you lived on,

cards.front: اگرچه باده فرح‌بخش و باد گل‌بیز است
cards.back:
Though wine is pleasurable, and though the breeze
Seems soaked in roses,

cards.front: تنت به ناز طبیبان نیازمند مباد
cards.back:
May your dear body never need
A doctor’s expertise,

cards.front: گداخت جان که شود کار دل تمام و نشد
cards.back:
To have my heart achieve its goal
grief melted my sad soul – to no effect;

cards.front: حسب حالی ننوشتی و شد ایامی چند
cards.back:
You’ve sent no word of how you are
It’s been a few days…quite a few –

cards.front: نقد صوفی نه همه صافی بی‌غش باشد
cards.back: Not every Sufi’s trustworthy, or pure in spirit,

cards.front: مژده ای دل که مسیحا نفسی می‌آید
cards.back: Good news, my heart! The breath of Christ is wafting here;

cards.front: دیر است که دلدار پیامی نفرستاد
cards.back:
My love has sent no letter for
A long time now – I’ve heard
No salutations from him, no
Inquiries, not one word;

cards.front: شراب بی‌غش و ساقی خوش دو دام رهند
cards.back:
Good wine, that doesn’t stupefy,
That’s served by someone pretty – who
Among the wise men of this world
Escapes the snares set by these two?

cards.front: آنکه رخسار تو را رنگ گل و نسرین داد
cards.back:
The one who gave your lovely face its rosy
red and white
Can give me peace, and patience to endure
my wretched plight;

cards.front: یاد باد آنکه نهانت نظری با ما بود
cards.back:
May I remember always when
Your glance in secrecy met mine,

cards.front: واعظان کاین جلوه در محراب و منبر می‌کنند
cards.back:
These preachers who make such a show
Of pulpit piety
Act in a wholly different way
When no one’s there to see.

cards.front: شکفته شد گل خمری و گشت بلبل مست
cards.back: The nightingales are drunk, wine-red roses appear,

cards.front: مسلمانان مرا وقتی دلی بود
cards.back:
Moslems, time was I had a heart –
a good one too,

cards.front: باشد ای دل که در میکده‌ها بگشایند
cards.back:
Perhaps, my heart, the wine-shops’ doors
will soon be opened wide,

cards.front: ما بدین در نه پی حشمت و جاه آمده‌ایم
cards.back:
We haven’t traveled to this door
For wealth or mastery,

cards.front: گفتم غم تو دارم گفتا غمت سر آید
cards.back:
I said, “The grief I feel is all for you”;
she said, “Your grief will end”;

cards.front: معاشران ز حریف شبانه یاد آرید
cards.back:
Dear friends, that friend with whom we once
Caroused at night –
His willing services to us
And our delight…remember this.

cards.front: شب قدر است و طی شد نامهٔ هجر
cards.back:
It is the Night of Power,
Grief’s scroll is rolled away,

cards.front: ای خرم از فروغ رخت لاله‌زار عمر
cards.back:
Life’s garden flourishes when your
Bright countenance is here.

cards.front: گل‌عذاری ز گلستان جهان ما را بس
cards.back:
Of all the roses in the world
A rosy face…is quite enough for me;

cards.front: مقام امن و می بی‌غش و رفیق شفیق
cards.back:
A loving friend, good wine, a place secure
From enemies –

cards.front: دوش پنهان گفت با من کاردانی تیزهوش
cards.back:
Last night the wine-seller, a man
Of great experience,
Conversed with me (and here I share
With you his secret sense):

cards.front: راهیست راه عشق که هیچش کناره نیست
cards.back:
Love's road's an endless road
where there's no place to rest,

cards.front: دلا رفیق سفر بخت نیک‌خواهت بس
cards.back:
My heart, good fortune is the only friend
Going along beside you that you need;

cards.front: گرچه بر واعظ شهر این سخن آسان نشود
cards.back:
Although our preacher might not like
to hear me mention it,
He'll never be a Moslem while
he's such a hypocrite.

cards.front: اگر شراب خوری جرعه‌ای فشان بر خاک
cards.back:
When you drink wine, sprinkle
A few drops on the ground –

cards.front: دلم ربوده لولی‌وشیست شورانگیز
cards.back:
My heart was stolen by a lout,
A gypsy-featured lad

cards.front: رسید مژده که ایام غم نخواهد ماند
cards.back:
Good news! The days of grief and pain
won't stay like this –

cards.front: فاش می‌گویم و از گفته خود دلشادم
cards.back:
I'll say it openly, and be
Happy to speak my mind –

cards.front: حاشا که من به موسم گل ترک می کنم
cards.back:
Ah, God forbid that I relinquish wine
When roses are in season;

cards.front: صبا به لطف بگو آن غزال رعنا را
cards.back:
Mild breeze of morning, gently tell
That errant, elegant gazelle

cards.front: مژده وصل تو کو کز سر جان برخیزم
cards.back:
Where is the news we'll meet, that from
This life to greet you there
I may arise?

cards.front: من دوستدار روی خوش و موی دلکشم
cards.back:
My love's for pretty faces,
For heart-bewitching hair;

cards.front: حجاب چهره جان می‌شود غبار تنم
cards.back:
My body's dust is as a veil
Spread out to hide
My soul – happy that moment when
It's drawn aside!

cards.front: نفس باد صبا مشک‌فشان خواهد شد
cards.back:
The musky morning breeze
Will gently blow again,
Once more the old world will
Turn young and grow again;

cards.front: اگر آن ترک شیرازی به دست آرد دل ما را
cards.back:
If that Shirazi Turk would take
My heart within his loving hand

cards.front: عشق‌بازی و جوانی و شراب لعل‌فام
cards.back:
Flirtatious games, and youth,
And wine like rubies glowing;

cards.front: چون جامه ز تن برکشد آن مشکین‌خال
cards.back:
A black mole graced his face; he stripped, and shone
Incomparable in splendor as the moon;

cards.front: عمری ز پی مراد ضایع دارم
cards.back:
Desire's destroyed my life; what gifts have I
Been given by the blindly turning sky?

cards.front: من حاصل عمر خود ندارم جز غم
cards.back: What does life give me in the end but sorrow?

cards.front: هر دوست که دم زد ز وفا دشمن شد
cards.back: Each friend turned out to be an enemy,

cards.front: با می به کنار جوی می‌باید بود
cards.back: With wine beside a gently flowing brook – this is best;
